about_the_game:
🔥 Ever dreamed of being a courier who delivers packages in style?

In CyberStrike Chronicles, that’s exactly what you do.

Master your traversal skills and race across the city as Azure Stormrider, a daring courier delivering high-value packages in the most stylish ways possible.

🎮 What’s the game like?

Think Crazy Taxi meets Spider-Man’s swinging mechanics.

💬 FAQ

Q: How many people are working on this game?

A: Just two! Myself and an animator.

Q: Who made the animations?

A: We did! All animations are hand-keyed — no motion capture — inspired by Spider-Man games and gymnastics moves.

Q: Is this a superhero game?

A: Not really. Azure isn’t a superhero — she’s a skilled courier navigating the urban jungle with agility and style.

Q: Is this a Spider-Man clone?

A: Nope, but the references are there. CyberStrike Chronicles is all about traversal. No combat, no superpowers — just pure movement and momentum.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6006, 2.0 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700, 3.60 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB

short_description: Swing through Neon Spires with style as a daring courier, mastering speed, flow, and gravity-defying tricks. Use your cybernetic arm to deliver high-stakes packages in record time across a futuristic city built for momentum and creativity.
supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
